title: FTFuzz Mutation Ontology Schema
description: Four-layer ontology for LLM-driven semantic fuzzing policy

RegionRole.description: Input Semantic Role — what role does a region of input bytes play?

enum_descriptions.reachability_region: Bytes needed to reach PreState (e.g., mandatory structural tokens)
enum_descriptions.declaration_region: Bytes that declare schema/type/DTD — syntactic metadata
enum_descriptions.constraint_region: Bytes that express a constraint or assertion on content
enum_descriptions.reference_region: Bytes that reference another part of the input (IDs, names, refs)
enum_descriptions.payload_region: Bytes that carry the actual data/content payload
enum_descriptions.tail_region: Bytes after the main payload (suffix, terminator, closing delimiter)
enum_descriptions.length_field: Bytes encoding a length/size of another region
enum_descriptions.count_field: Bytes encoding a count of elements
enum_descriptions.offset_field: Bytes encoding an offset to another region
enum_descriptions.delimiter_region: Bytes that act as separators between elements
enum_descriptions.container_region: Bytes that enclose/contain other regions (tags, brackets, braces)
enum_descriptions.unknown_region: Bytes whose role cannot be determined from available context

DesiredEffect.description: Desired semantic effect on an input region

enum_descriptions.preserve: Keep this region intact — critical for reachability
enum_descriptions.empty: Replace region content with empty/minimal placeholder
enum_descriptions.create: Insert new content for this region role
enum_descriptions.make_non_empty: Ensure the region is not empty
enum_descriptions.remove_or_forbid: Either remove existing content or forbid tokens from appearing
enum_descriptions.create_or_preserve: Either create the region or preserve it if it already exists
enum_descriptions.create_or_keep_non_empty: Create region or ensure existing content is non-empty
enum_descriptions.mutate: Apply byte-level mutation within this region
enum_descriptions.move_earlier: Move this region to an earlier position in the input
enum_descriptions.repair_consistency: Fix cross-region consistency (e.g., update length field after mutation)
enum_descriptions.unsupported: Effect cannot be expressed with available operations

enum_descriptions.PRESERVE_REGION: Do not mutate bytes in this range
enum_descriptions.DELETE_REGION: Remove all bytes in this range
enum_descriptions.EMPTY_REGION: Replace region content with a minimal placeholder
enum_descriptions.REMOVE_TOKENS: Scan for and remove specific token patterns
enum_descriptions.FORBID_TOKENS: Prevent specific token patterns from being inserted
enum_descriptions.INSERT_TOKEN_IN_REGION: Insert tokens only within a grounded scope
enum_descriptions.DUPLICATE_REGION: Copy a region and insert the copy elsewhere
enum_descriptions.MOVE_REGION_EARLIER: Relocate a region to an earlier byte offset
enum_descriptions.EXTEND_AFTER_REGION: Append content after a region (from seed self-bytes)
enum_descriptions.FOCUS_RANGE_HAVOC: Apply standard havoc mutations within a bounded range
enum_descriptions.PRESERVE_AWARE_HAVOC: Apply havoc mutations while avoiding preserve regions
enum_descriptions.REJECT_UNSUPPORTED: The requested effect cannot be lowered to an action

OntologyAtom.description: A single ontology atom mapping input region semantics to a desired effect

atom_id.description: Unique identifier for this atom (e.g., A1, A2)

evidence_tokens.description: Concrete input tokens that signal this region (e.g., '<!DOCTYPE')

confidence.description: LLM confidence in this atom's correctness

rationale.description: Short explanation of why this atom is proposed

grounding_requirements.description: What must exist in the seed for this atom to be grounded

OntologyAtomSet.description: A set of ontology atoms for one transition + desired outcome

transition_id.description: Target transition this atom set applies to

desired_outcome.description: Target branch outcome from transition metadata (not from LLM)

non_input_symbols.description: Program state symbols that are NOT input literals

ProgramStateLayer.description: Layer 1: Program state concepts mapped to input regions

concepts.PreState: Program state before the barrier branch
concepts.Barrier: The conditional branch that must be steered
concepts.PostState: Program state after successfully crossing the barrier
concepts.BranchCondition: The condition expression at the barrier
concepts.DesiredOutcome: Whether the branch should be taken (true) or not taken (false)
concepts.StateVariable: A program variable whose value is relevant to the barrier
concepts.ConditionAtom: A decomposed part of the branch condition

InputSemanticRoleLayer.description: Layer 2: Semantic roles that input byte regions can play

SemanticEffectLayer.description: Layer 3: Desired effects on input regions to steer the barrier

target_successor_bb.description: The successor BB that leads toward the target/PostState

desired_outcome.description: true if target_successor_bb == true_successor_bb, false otherwise
